verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's developer docs say users can import its OpenAPI 3 specification files, available for both the v1 and v2 APIs, into their tool of choice. That is a first-party, machine-readable spec offered for download. The evidence is a single docs sentence with no stated download location. missing for 10: explicit download URL or location of the spec files, independent or hands-on corroboration that the files are retrievable and complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both v1 and v2 APIs) into your tool of choice
